title: Fixed-comparison graded ordinary counit bijections
statement: Fix all data of the fixed-comparison ordinary counit witness, including a comparison isomorphism a, L, H, e and t, and assume the transported-arrow equation and invariant condition. Then postcomposition by t after counitHomTransport is bijective in every ordinary graded Hom degree.

proof.text: Construct an ordinary adjunction on the actual bounded constructible categories: choose the geometric-fiber coefficient construction and its locally finite compact-support realization, apply the stage adjunction, then transport through the native geometric Brown constructible comparison. This is private theorem ordinary_adjunction in the Lean proof.
Lift the invariant ordinary transpose to a native q:H→M with the ordinary and common-stage right-object identifications.

Prove the cone-detection hypothesis explicitly. If the ordinary composite vq vanishes, ordinary adjunction naturality and the underlying comparison show forget(nativeShriek(v)) followed by t is zero. Apply the transported-arrow equation and common-stage faithfulness. Naturality of a and the scalar adjunction identify this with VX(v) followed by e being zero; cancel e. The given e and the lift identification give VX(H)≅VX(M). Apply the cone criterion and compose with d to show that the ordinary transpose is invertible.

For every K and r, compose Iso.homCongr for the shifted transpose isomorphism with Adjunction.shiftedHomEquiv (WeilConjectures.CategoryTheory.Shift.AdjunctionHomEquiv). Explicit full-subcategory shift comparisons identify the resulting bijection with the required counitHomTransport followed by shifted t. All categorical glue is proved privately in this module.

theorem native_exceptional_ordinary_counit_graded (R : Family l D)
    (X Y : Space D) (VX : ForgetModel D l R X) (VY : ForgetModel D l R Y)
    (f₀ : X.base ⟶ Y.base)
    [IsSeparated f₀.left] [LocallyOfFiniteType f₀.left] [QuasiCompact f₀.left]
    (S : CoefficientSystem D l f₀) (c : Compactification (geometricMap D f₀))
    (a : nativeShriek D l f₀ ⋙ VY.functor ≅
      VX.functor ⋙ (S.ring.operation c .closed).F)
    (L : W D l Y) (H : W D l X)
    (e : VX.functor.obj H ≅ (S.ring.operation c .closed).G.obj (VY.functor.obj L))
    (t : WeilComplex.forget.obj ((nativeShriek D l f₀).obj H) ⟶
      WeilComplex.forget.obj L)
    (ht : ((ProEtale.adicLowerStar l (closureMap D Y)).rightDerivedFunctor ⋙
      sectionDerived l (geometric D Y).base.left
        (R.data (geometric D Y)).realization).map t =
      VY.realization.inv.app ((nativeShriek D l f₀).obj H) ≫
        (rho D l R Y).map (a.hom.app H ≫ (S.ring.operation c .closed).F.map e.hom ≫
          (S.ring.operation c .closed).adjunction.counit.app (VY.functor.obj L)) ≫
        VY.realization.hom.app L)
    (hinv : (t ≫ (shiftFunctorZero _ ℤ).inv.app (WeilComplex.forget.obj L)) ∈
      CyclicDerivedHomInvariants (WeilSheaf.frobeniusPullback D.k₀ l Y.base.left)
        ((nativeShriek D l f₀).obj H).obj L.obj) :
    ∀ (K : W D l X) (r : ℤ), Function.Bijective
      (fun v : CyclicDerivedHom (WeilSheaf.frobeniusPullback D.k₀ l X.base.left)
        K.obj H.obj r ↦ counitHomTransport D l f₀ K H r v ≫ t⟦r⟧')
